comment: No reader-facing document may hardcode a rustdv version number. A version in prose is correct the day it is typed and wrong at the next release, and nothing about a release reminds anyone to update it: the packaged crates.io README once told readers for weeks after the 0.1 launch that crates.io held 'the 0.0.1 name reservation'. The live mechanisms replace it — the crates.io badge for the version, `cargo add rustdv` for the dependency line, rust-toolchain.toml for the compiler. CHANGELOG.md, STATUS.md, and the design log are out of scope on purpose: versioned release notes and dated records name the versions they describe. Mutation-tested both ways. No simulator needed.
